horoscopes.horoscope: You are very apprehensive about your possessions today, and will not like to share them. This mood may be because of someone particular. Affairs regarding love, Ganesha says, are progressing fine, and your married life will bloom. You tend to be calculative, foresees Ganesha. Though you may wish to spend money buying gifts for your loved one, you may end up being a miser. Don’t worry about what you get but how much you give as the joy of giving is more powerful than that of receiving, feels Ganesha. Happiness will come your way today as you will get rewards in tangible and intangible manner. You will be happy and your physical, mental health will remain good. Restlessness will reduce to a great extent and you will be able to focus better. Ganesha feels that today your approach towards money matters will be more pragmatic, which will help you achieve desired financial targets in relatively shorter term. You will feel realistic today and tend to analyze everything from a practical point of view as you want to make some tangible gains. However, Ganesha says that you also need to focus on work. Prioritize your work if needed. Remember, preparation is half the battle won.

This day has been earmarked for beautification, a makeover, says Ganesha. You are likely to remain preoccupied with ways to enhance your looks and appearance. A new, stylish hair do, face packs and massages, trendy outfits and accessories could be in store. You will, subconsciously, be doing all that you can do, to get noticed by others. Be sure you will get all the attention and interest your efforts merit. You are likely to experience a close relationship with your partner. You may nurture this relationship by exhibiting an enduring passion. After all, nothing is wrong in expressing true love. Your love life will turn blissful tonight, feels Ganesha. Today you will realise the value of good health and work on those lines. You can spend more time at gym, or doing yoga or aerobics. You can challenge your own limits in exercising. You will feel good internally as you will not waste energy. Ganesha feels that this is the right time to think about putting a sum aside in some fixed deposit schemes or in something that gives you regular returns. You will not be in mood to take financial risks. You are likely to be very self-centered. You will stick to your principles at the workplace. This inflexibility may be understood as stubbornness by others and it may compromise your reputation. Try to be flexible, suggests Ganesha.

Your physical appearance and personal attitude will see a marked improvement today, predicts Ganesha. A well-groomed you will climb up the popularity chart among peers, friends and members of the opposite sex. You will keep people under your spell with your wit and wisdom both at the workplace and at social gatherings. Romance is also in the air. You will spend an unforgettable time with your spouse and parents. You will tend to make everybody happy by giving some unconventional gifts. The time you share with your family will certainly make your day, feels Ganesha. Ganesha feels as the stars are not in your favour, you may feel tired quite soon. Besides, today you should do only those tasks which will yield good results. The time is good for wooing your partner. You need good health and good humour today. You will be spending money today for things that are non-essential. You may also spend money behind opposite sex, traveling and momentary pleasures, or on unexpected events. It’s not a smooth day on the professional front. Technical problems may creep in via a virus and irk your nerves. You will put more energies to identifying the root cause of the problem. Failure to meet deadlines must not put you off, suggests Ganesha.

You will be firing all cylinders in the creativity department, says Ganesha. Even your colleagues may pitch in, and will give you new ideas to make your work better. Those looking for a new job will ace the interview and clear the selection process as easily as clearing the fog from their glasses. A romantic rendezvous with your loved one will make your evening the most delightful time you’ve had. Having a candlelit dinner at a poolside lounge or inviting him or her to your home and cooking with your special partner will unfold a great romantic story, feels Ganesha. The workload may be heavy on this busy day. But, instead of doing all the tasks yourself, just distribute some assignments amongst your juniors and people whom you trust. In the evening, spend your time with close pals to rejuvenate. Today is an auspicious day for going out for a movie, or planning a dinner with your beloved, or looking to woo someone of the opposite sex just by spending money. Today, you shall be more innovative than usual. Your creativity will reflect in the work you do and this will surely impress your colleagues. You will move ahead with your projects comfortably. Your ideas may give good results for your company, feels Ganesha.

A challenging day awaits you. You will face some tensions and problems, however this doesn’t mean you will not be able to complete all your work successfully. Your personal life will proceed as usual, however expectations from you at the work-front will increase. You need to maintain a balance between your home and work-place, says Ganesha. You may feel a great relief tonight. You must set apart some time for your beloved so that your relationship brings you boundless joy. An SMS or talking over a phone will keep you in touch with your loved one, says Ganesha. Brimming with vigour, this is the right time to devise your work strategy and put them into action. With your concentration soaring and self-confidence also rising, you shall be able to complete your work within the preset time-limits. You need to channelise your energies positively today and in the right direction to make more money. Avoid spending too much time browsing the net for earning a quick buck. A career-oriented day will fill your heart with a professional mood, envisages Ganesha. An encouraging development on the career front will help you move upwards on the corporate ladder. You tend to learn something new related to techniques, projects or objectives and the like.

Play dodge ball with prejudice today. Do not let intolerance find shelter in you today, advises Ganesha. Instead, chances are you will seek to find love, affection and goodwill among those around you. Stay away from negativity as it may bog you down. Ganesha counsels you to have the courage to stand by your convictions. You will be able to convince your lover. You might feel like gifting something precious to the most precious person in your life. Trust your partner. Long term commitment is on the cards now, foresees Ganesha. On this wonderful day – you shall be able to do everything that you always wanted to do – but could not do earlier – for some reason or the other. Your enthusiasm will inspire others to work zealously, too. Today is a favourable day to sit with your bank statement and see the source of income and expenses to get a better idea about where you stand and to have an overview of the future. Ganesha thinks you may not be at the right destination or may not apply the right thing at the right time. You will be dependent on luck today. At work, others might feel you are working with ease but on the contrary, you will be putting in a lot of efforts.

Everyone has a dream, but only few have the fortune to realise them. Be among the lucky ones today as you see your dream project materialise and take its first steps towards a successful future. But all good things have humble beginnings. What matters is that you had a dream, and dreaming it was the hardest part, reminds Ganesha. You may express your true love today. Communicating your feelings to your loved one can help you keep misunderstandings at bay. A sweet SMS to your partner can make you feel at home. Take help from your loved one, if you don’t know how to handle such things. The day holds significance from health point of view. You should avoid comsuming junk food. You should eat protein and vitamin rich food instead. Today, you should not lose energy. Avoid exhaustive tasks and maintain energy levels. Remember, health is wealth. Ganesha feels that this is the time to cut back, relax and enjoy what providence has provided you. It’s not a good day to target at huge fiscal gains as stars are not in your favour. Expect an average day today. You may remain unenthusiastic at work as you may find yourself engaged in clearing pending tasks. You may feel you are bound to take responsibilities and not driven by your own pursuit.

Ganesha predicts that you shall work towards building a better future. But do not expect radical or dynamic changes. Cruise control is the best way to go for now, says Ganesha. Patience in itself will reap rich benefits. You will be able to express to your lover frankly whatever is in your mind today. Your sense of humor may play an important role to get closer to your loved one. Your easy-going nature will smoothen the road to a blissful relationship, says Ganesha. You should strike a balance between life and work. Working excessively might make your body react adversely. Besides, you may face criticism from others which may make you feel low. But you don’t criticize others. This will make your day nice. Money spent today will be an investment and it’s not going to be wasted. If you spend money behind strengthening your personal or professional relations, it will be ideal investment for the day. Ganesha foresees that the day doesn’t favor you much. You may not feel energetic and confident today. Your low spirits will not allow you to be productive. But you need to be alert while performing routine tasks. Doing meditation daily will keep you cool, says Ganesha.

Expect a call to late-night revelry and a chance to binge. But you don’t seem to be in the mood to let your hair loose and party, says Ganesha. However tempting it may be, your serious side will take over and you shall deny the offer. No wonder they like that sensible head on your shoulders. You will be heavily occupied in a busy schedule. You may not be able to spare much time for your sweetheart. Keep in touch with your loved one, suggests Ganesha. Your partner will forgive you if you remain honest to yourself. On this vibrant day, you will prefer to remain occupied with some or the other task. But, plan your daily schedule and don’t waste your time and energy after futile activities. Work swiftly, and avoid stretching yourself beyond your limits. Today you will be very pragmatic in financial matters and will avoid all temptations to spend impulsively. You may find it tough, but if you persist you will see that it is not impossible. You will have an action-packed time at the workplace, foresees Ganesha. You may face challenges while making an important decision. It is a day on which you need to balance your personal and professional life. Prioritizing your work after careful consideration will boost your mental spirit, feels Ganesha.

The chances of you meeting financial success are few, but they are there nonetheless, says Ganesha. If you really want to improve your account balance and settle all the burgeoning debts, focus on what all needs to be done, and get it done without delay. You will make merry later in the day and will enjoy the company of your loved ones. But you will have free time despite all of this, and will get lured into unnecessary spending, especially on recreational activities. Spend your money prudently to avoid financial crisis in the future. You will feel confident with your loved one, foresees Ganesha. With a desire for a passionate love relationship, you will spend a romantic time with your sweetheart. A perfect day if you want to disclose a special feeling, secret or a long desired plan, feels Ganesha. Your understanding of your limitations would be good so you will be practical about things and will not stretch yourself beyond your own limits. It’s not time to challenge yourself. It’s time to know what challenges are and how smartly you can deal with them. Today, your brain-cells are active enough to grasp and learn. How about learning more regarding investment or speculation? Alternatively, you can invest money behind some piano lessons or any art. A gainful day is waiting for you. Your mind will be lively and unusually inventive at the workplace. Your ideas and skills will fetch appreciation from your boss or senior authorities. Get yourself armed with new skills to progress in your career.

Work, work, work! That is what will pay rich dividends. Of course, a pat on the back does matter, and with your commitment record, you may be getting a lot of it! You may back off from taking risks, and yet want change. Ganesha wonders how you will fulfill your wish. Cosmic undercurrents reveal that issues will engross your domestic affairs. Sorting out issues with your lover can help you create a lasting relationship. Boost trust with your partner, advises Ganesha. You may feel like working from home today or you may feel like spending lesser hours at office. It’s because you have worked a lot in the last few days. Now is the time to relax. You can call your friends home. Ganesha warns you against purchase of electronic gadgets or things that have just been introduced in the market. Such investments will give you only short term joy and you must try to control your temptation. The day demands you to strike a perfect balance between your personal and professional needs. You may find it difficult to concentrate on your work due to personal problems. As a result, you may feel a bit nervous today while taking some important decisions, says Ganesha.

Arguments lead nowhere, and why argue when, at the end of the day, you can step back and watch them end up with egg on their faces, break a leg, get crushed under a falling safe, or otherwise suffer the numerous disasters you wish them to, for disagreeing with you. You will end up having the last laugh, so you might as well use your time more effectively, says Ganesha. You may not give adequate time to your loved one, says Ganesha. Avoid being inflexible as you may end up hurting near and dear ones. Listen to your sweetheart as it may sort out some important issues, suggests Ganesha. Today you won’t think just from the heart but will also use your mind and logic. Because this is not natural to you, it may make you feel tired but it’s just a matter of a day or two before you are back to your original self. Today, you can plan to visit some nearby places. Alternatively, may be you can go for long distance drive and just breathe some fresh air. Remember, every investment has some return, tangible or intangible. The day finds you in an expressive mood. Plus, your confidence level will also be high, foresees Ganesha. Your colleagues will listen to your instructions. The dexterity with which you will handle communications will make your routine tasks easier.
